{
  "name": "kane-qe",
  "version": "2.0.0",
  "description": "Watches kane-cli (KaneAI) runs in Claude Code: a band above the prompt with the kane mascot, a pane for runs, steps, failures and assurance coverage, and a nudge to test what Claude just changed",
  "author": {
    "name": "TestMu AI"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/LambdaTest/kane-claude-plugin",
  "repository": "https://github.com/LambdaTest/kane-claude-plugin",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://www.testmuai.com/legal/privacy/",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://www.testmuai.com/legal/terms-of-service/",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "kaneai",
    "kane-cli",
    "lambdatest",
    "testing",
    "qa",
    "browser-testing",
    "e2e"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "afterChange": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After Claude changes code",
      "description": "offer: show a Test this change button. auto: Claude tests the change before it finishes. off: do nothing.",
      "options": [
        "offer",
        "auto",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "offer"
    },
    "kaneCommand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "kane-cli command",
      "description": "How to launch kane-cli for read-only checks (cover gaps), split on spaces",
      "default": "kane-cli"
    }
  }
}
